name: The Haunted Sisters
overview: After moving into an old suburban house in late-20th-century Belfast, the Raphael family begins experiencing terrifying supernatural events. As strange noises, cryptic messages, and ghostly apparitions plague their home, eldest daughter Ellen and her younger sister Elsie uncover the mystery of an unsolved murder connected to the property. When Elsie suddenly disappears, the entire family is drawn into a desperate fight against the dark secrets haunting House No. 16 before they become its next victims.
